assessment.reason: The final plan accurately covers seven transitions, distinct summary/h1 focus and eight checks. It corrects initial reverse-traversal breadth by choosing literal forward Tab. It distinguishes the profile as context, and explicitly leaves broader resource authorization and presentation-absence interpretation qualified rather than claiming supplied markup facts.

The plan requires actual sequential Tab from the observed summary after Close to focused application Back, Enter, and independent returned introduction-h1 focus. It rejects mouse Back, browser-history Back and direct focus as proof and retains failed prerequisites.

Unanswered observable checkpoints, all-request method denial, pre-entry exact-origin navigation/redirect/popup guards, blocked-analytics effects and no excluded actions are specified. The narrower profile is not used to grant third-party permission: unresolved affected requests must not be allowed pending resolution or must be conservatively blocked.

The plan calls demonstrated gaps documentary, labels future website acceptance unexecuted, preserves provenance/exclusions, and separates observed wrong behavior from unavailable prerequisites. C12 presentation absence remains an interpretive proposal, with partial source support disclosed. No site defect or pass is claimed.

The proper project command and actual exit/output are retained. Fourteen meaningful planned Gherkin scenarios include negative focus, policy and incomplete-evidence paths; eight-check mapping and manual full-source review supplement the limited checker. Actual profile, spec-lint and record-check results are explicitly separated from browser proof.

A one-document revision is supported by actual frozen-source comparisons and captured offline checks. Actual cross-examination narrows reverse traversal and boundary/persistence interpretations; adjudication records alternatives, consequences, dissent and unresolved runtime evidence. No application behavior change, live verdict or measured benefit is inferred.

comparison.reason: Separate evaluators and verifier retained task/coverage observations. One observation on related known tasks and visible conditions does not establish a comparative winner; live deployment comparability is unverified for UX.

limitations: One observation on a related known task, not a general benefit benchmark.
CLI JSONL omits some native child lifecycle events; child identities and history-free dispatches rely on retained role reports/roster plus the qualified inheritance probe.
All resource timing precision and unavailable measurements remain explicit; no cost or efficiency conclusion.
Offline planning only; no deployed site, browser, DOM, key/focus, analytics effects, live guard enforcement or deployment identity observed. No network/connector access used.

Future third-party subresource authorization and host capability remain unresolved. Full questionnaire/mobile/results/submission/performance/accessibility certification and source redistribution excluded.

Workflow cross-examination role continuity migrated to fresh contexts after actual followup actor-not-found errors. Each replacement read its own complete saved report and all initial peer reports after barrier. This is not uninterrupted same-context continuation.

Exact internal dispatch/return events and measured aggregate agent-seconds/CPU/token usage are unavailable from the collaboration API; roster retains local UTC observations and child-reported clocks; budget retains wall proxies and allocation bounds, not fabricated zero usage.
Delivery cross retention/return exceeded nominal worker deadline despite available-results requests. No extra investigation or quality retry dispatched at expiry.

Operator-supplied candidate and whole-prepared-input target hashes retained. Exact canonical enclosing manifest/digest procedure not supplied; per-file hashes, full original bytes, bundled skill resource comparisons and input immutability independently retained.

Fresh verifier was shown only 12 mechanically whitelisted claims and original sources, not full role reports or final report. It covered all 12: 11 supported and C12 partly supported as an interpretation. This audit does not prove all omitted claims or entire specification correctness.
Presentation-level absence is an adopted interpretation; DOM deletion, accessibility-tree behavior and answer persistence after return are not verified facts.

QA in-memory probe has full role report but lacks a separate raw command transcript. Delivery probe has exact retained command/output with UTC bounds, not exact separately measured command-start instant.
rg unavailable and BusyBox find lacks -printf; failed probes retained; fallback file reads/Python used.

Structure validators check declared artifact identity/coverage and document syntax only; they do not prove source reasoning, factual correctness, independent cognition from labels, or permission to implement/deploy.

Final run-check is executed after this record is frozen. Its exact output/argv/exit are saved as companion run-check-final.json and run-check-final-command.json outside this artifact manifest to avoid a self-referential digest cycle.
Independent criteria were applied qualitatively after outputs using predeclared criteria; operational grading interpretation was not a validated standardized scoring rubric.
Original method coverage and artifacts are unchanged. Later qualification and its identities are separate; entered metadata does not establish its own truth.
